newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan ends unchanged against US dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan ends unchanged against US dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed unchanged at 8.2970 against the U.S. dollar in dull trading in Shanghai on Friday with business slowing down as usual ahead of the weekend, traders said.
The weighted average price on Thursday was 8.2965.
The yuan opened higher at 8.2965 and hit an intraday high of 8.2960 early in the session.
It then consolidated and moved around 8.2970 for most of the session, hitting a low of 8.2972 in late trading.
Trading was dull with most business done at about 8.2969, traders said.

Dealers said the yuan started to face heavy downward pressure after opening higher which prevented it from breaching the 8.2960 resistance level. In addition, traders were as usual reluctant to do heavy business on Friday, they said.
Dealers said they expected the yuan to continue to move around the 8.2970 level early next week.
The yuan was down at 6.5600 from 6.5206 against 100 Japanese yen and down at 1.0717 from 1.0690 vs the Hong Kong dollar.
